title: Kept-Program Concession on Protected Substitute Prices — Contract Pricing Agreement
content:
# Kept-program concession on a protected substitute price — Contract Pricing Agreement

The program concession follows the programs the customer keeps with Corbett, as those programs' own records show: an active StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program (a StockSmart program whose status is active) and an active VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machine (a VendPoint machine whose status is active).

| Active StockSmart program | Active VendPoint machine | Concession |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 1.0 percent off |
| Yes | No | 0.5 percent off |
| No | Yes | 0.5 percent off |
| No | No | Nothing off |

An amount equal to that percent of the protected price is taken off the protected price before its rounding to four decimal places.

Hypothetical example: both programs active and a protected price of 8.0000: 1.0 percent of 8.0000 is 0.0800, giving 7.9200.
